name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A toolkit and marketplace of command-line wrappers that let AI agents directly operate ordinary desktop software (like Blender, Photoshop-alikes, or note apps) the same way a human would click through menus.
buyer: A software vendor or power-user community that wants their existing desktop app to be usable by AI agents without building an entire API from scratch.
business_use_cases: A niche software vendor (e.g. a CAD or audio tool maker) commissions or builds a CLI wrapper so customers can automate it with AI agents, as a competitive feature.
An agency specializing in AI workflow automation builds and sells custom CLI wrappers for clients' in-house legacy tools that have no API.
A community maintainer builds a wrapper for a popular niche app, lists it on the CLI-Hub marketplace, and takes paid requests for custom features.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid, contracted development of a CLI wrapper for a specific piece of software a client wants AI agents to control.
Run a hosted, maintained version of a popular wrapper (with updates as the underlying app changes) and charge a small usage fee.

steal_this: Pick one desktop app you use constantly that has no API, build a CLI wrapper for its most annoying repetitive task this weekend, and publish it to the CLI-Hub.
